pointer_source: Ruby Advisory Database / candidate survey (metadata only)

kept_files.note: Git::Lib#fetch is upstream-verbatim: the argument-list construction, including the order of the remote relative to the option flags and the inserted '--' separator, is exactly the code the fix commit changed

stand_ins.replaces: Git::Lib#command, which spawns the git process
stand_ins.with: a recorder that stores the argument list it is given and runs nothing
stand_ins.note: captures the argv so the property is observable in-process; it decides nothing about the argument order

reduction_removed: all Git::Lib methods and state unrelated to fetch
the real process execution, logging and output handling inside command
pov_note: Benign control and proof-of-vulnerability probes authored by the Corsair chain at run time; none authored here. Property observable in-process via the recorded argument list: a remote value that looks like an option reaches the runner as an option (no separator before it) on one variant and as a positional argument after a separator on the other. No outbound network and no git binary.
